author: CommanderPotato
quote: This game doesn’t feel like a GTA game. Why is this game like a life simulator? Why do I have to workout and go do shopping in this game? I dont care about that ****. The games graphics are alright, but I expected more advanced and sharper graphics. Mechanics are awful. Feels like a Ubisoft game. Lots of bugs and glitches. Boring. GTA 5 was lot better. Im dissapointed.
